theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_sd_jr_moving_eval_derivative
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : ℂ → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (G : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (c t : ℂ), (∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.coeff d (F z).val) (c * MvPolynomial.coeff d G.val) t) → ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ n → HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -z) ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[r] (F z).val)) (c * MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -t) ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[r] G.val) - MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -t) ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[r + 1] (F t).val)) t
